user.title: Pudong Veolia Water
user.description:
Enter the account number (销根号) on your water bill. Adding performs one real bill query.

Note: this endpoint returns bills for anyone who knows the account number; keep it private.

error.invalid_cid: Account number must be 5–20 letters or digits
error.invalid_account: Account not recognised (wrong number, or the API changed)
error.no_bills: No bills found for this account

data_description.scan_interval_days: Meters are read every two months. Restarting HA does not query again; use update entity to refresh now.
